name: Default
shortDescription: Durable task queue and workflow orchestration engine for background jobs and AI agents, with its dashboard, REST API and gRPC engine in one container plus PostgreSQL.

alerts.message: Sign in with ADMIN_EMAIL (admin@example.com by default) and ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment variables; they are only applied on first start. Public sign-up is off: set SERVER_ALLOW_SIGNUP to true to let invited teammates register.

Workers connect over gRPC, which is not published on the domain. Run workers in the same environment, create an API token under Settings > API Tokens and set HATCHET_CLIENT_TOKEN, HATCHET_CLIENT_HOST_PORT=hatchet:7077 and HATCHET_CLIENT_TLS_STRATEGY=none.
